11:- Base URL: `https://api.venice.ai/api/v1`. Any OpenAI SDK works: set this base URL and send a Venice API key as the Bearer token.
12:- Access is self-serve, with no sales contact: create a key at https://venice.ai/settings/api. An agent can also pay per request with USDC from a Base or Solana wallet through [x402](https://docs.venice.ai/guides/integrations/x402-venice-api), with no account, or [mint its own key](https://docs.venice.ai/guides/integrations/generating-api-key-agent) by staking VVV.
20:- [Quick Start Guide](https://docs.venice.ai/getting-started/quick-start): Get your API key and make your first request in minutes
21:- [API Key Generation](https://docs.venice.ai/guides/getting-started/generating-api-key): Step-by-step guide to creating API keys
22:- [Managing API Keys](https://docs.venice.ai/guides/getting-started/managing-api-keys): Create, cap, track, update, and revoke API keys from code with an Admin key, including per-key usage from the billing endpoints
32:- [Responses API](https://docs.venice.ai/guides/features/responses-api): OpenAI-compatible `POST /responses` endpoint with typed output items for reasoning, messages, function calls, and web search. Stateless, supports streaming via SSE, API key or x402 wallet auth. OpenAI models are served natively (instructions, structured outputs, custom and Codex tools, encrypted reasoning replay). Other models are translated through Chat Completions, which supports `text.format` structured outputs and ignores hosted tools; see the limitations table
67:- [Crypto RPC](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/crypto/rpc): **Venice provides blockchain RPC access** — send JSON-RPC requests to Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Linea, Avalanche, BSC, Blast, zkSync Era, Starknet, Solana, and Robinhood Chain (mainnet + testnets). One API key, unified billing in Venice credits. Supports batch requests (up to 100), idempotent retries, and x402 wallet auth. No separate RPC provider signup needed
87:### API Keys
88:- [List API Keys](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/list): List your API keys
89:- [Get API Key](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/get): Get details for a specific API key
90:- [Create API Key](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/create): Create a new API key
91:- [Update API Key](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/update): Update an existing API key
92:- [Delete API Key](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/delete): Delete an API key
93:- [Generate Web3 Key](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/generate_web3_key/post): Generate API key via Web3 wallet signature
94:- [Rate Limits](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/rate_limits): Get rate limit configuration for an API key
95:- [Rate Limit Logs](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/rate_limit_logs): Get rate limit event logs
104:- [x402 Balance](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/x402/balance): Get wallet credit balance
105:- [x402 Top-Up](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/x402/top-up): Add USDC credits from a Base or Solana wallet
109:- [Rate Limiting](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/rate-limiting): Rate limits and best practices
172:- [Autonomous Agent API Key Creation](https://docs.venice.ai/guides/integrations/generating-api-key-agent): Let agents programmatically mint their own Venice API key by staking VVV on Base — no human interaction required
